query: On kornia >= 0.8.3 the pack fails to import (`cannot import name 'pad'`) because kornia no longer re-exports torch's pad from the pyramid module.

desired.outcome: OP's one-line shim (`pad = F.pad`, drop pad from kornia import) and pinning kornia==0.8.2 (maoper11) both confirmed working by later commenters in #494/#517.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
